limitations: One test cluster does not prove independent production storage, administrator or backup fault domains
Trial Object Lock is not a physical WORM certification and a component restart is not a power-loss test
One honest logical witness is assumed; no Byzantine quorum or malicious operator/administrator tolerance is claimed
The profile supports one log, view and target Secret per installation, and Deployment workloads
Kubernetes resourceVersion CAS and honest API server behavior are assumed; no surviving approved request through raw etcd revision rewind is claimed
Journal verification and Kubernetes CAS are separate operations; no cross-system transaction or exactly-once workload restart is claimed
Only the stated Kubernetes and test storage/runtime combination is exercised
A real Cilium network partition was not demonstrated; the core stale-owner fault model is a live paused process with a pending approved write
The final approved-write CAS proof explicitly accelerates test Lease expiry; it is not a natural fifteen-second failover timing claim
Stage 7 has not started; no release or production deployment performed
